content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","title":"Distance vs Displacement","quick":"Distance is the total path length travelled, no matter how winding. Displacement is the straight-line gap between start and end point, with direction. Distance is always equal or more than displacement.","full":"Think of Ishika walking to the kirana shop which is around the corner, not straight ahead. She walks 100 metres down the lane and 50 metres across to reach it - that is distance, the whole path she actually walked, 150 metres. But if you measure a straight line from her house directly to the shop, it might be only 120 metres - that is displacement, the shortest straight path with direction (say, north-east). If she walks to the shop and comes back home, distance is 300 metres (there and back), but displacement is zero because she ended where she started. Same journey, two different numbers: distance only cares about path length, displacement cares about final position relative to start, and always has a direction attached.","traps":["Saying distance and displacement are always equal","Forgetting displacement can be zero when you return to start","Not mentioning that displacement has direction but distance does not"],"misconception":"Children think distance and displacement are just two names for the same thing, the total length walked.","parent_questions":[{"q":"If you walk to the temple and back the same way, what is your displacement?","expected_answer_hint":"Zero, because you end up exactly where you started, even though distance covered is not zero."},{"q":"Which one, distance or displacement, can never be more than the other?","expected_answer_hint":"Displacement can never be more than distance; distance is always equal to or greater than displacement."}],"check_question":{"q":"Ishika walks 60 m east then 60 m west back to her starting point. What is her displacement?","options":["0 m","120 m","60 m"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! She returned to the start, so displacement is zero even though she walked 120 m.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Since she ends exactly where she began, displacement is zero, though total distance walked is 120 m."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A girl walking along a curved lane from her house to a small corner shop, with a straight dotted line also drawn between the house and the shop.","labels":[{"text":"path walked","position":"bottom"},{"text":"straight line","position":"top"},{"text":"house","position":"left"},{"text":"shop","position":"right"}]}}
